POWERFUL CLOTHES MOTH TRAP - Attracts and kills common clothes moths (Tineola bisselliella & Tinea pellionella) to protect your clothes and fabrics.

description: From the UK’s No.1 Moth Brand, Acana’s Moth Trap 10 Pack provides fast and effective protection against common clothes moths (Tineola bisselliella & Tinea pellionella). Each trap uses the latest HSE-approved natural pheromone to attract, trap, and kill adult male moths, helping to disrupt the breeding cycle and prevent damage to your favourite clothes, wool, cashmere, and fabrics. The non-toxic and insecticide-free formula makes it safe to use throughout the home – ideal for wardrobes, cupboards, drawers, and storage areas. Designed with convenience in mind, these folding traps offer extensive coverage and require no plastic cages, reducing waste while keeping your home protected. Trusted by households across the UK, Acana delivers proven, long-lasting moth protection with easy-to-use, recyclable traps that fit seamlessly into any space.
